title: Exact SAT reduction for bounded verifier prefixes and witness-search equivalences
claims: PrefixExtensionReducesToSAT provides a polynomial-time many-one query map into the exact reference SAT language for bounded verifier prefix extension.
SatIffWitnessSearch proves the equivalence of SAT in P and polynomial-time witness selection for every fixed verifier and bound.
SatIffLogWitnessCodes proves the equivalence of SAT in P and logarithmic-length witness codes with a polynomial-time decoder for every fixed verifier and bound.
LogWitnessCodesInP constructs a polynomial-time decider under a restricted witness-code hypothesis. SAT in P and the general witness-code hypothesis are both left open.
